title: Forgiven Education Overpayments and the Entitlement Days Restored
content:
**Liaison note — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education) restorations after a reduction of a Chapter 30, Chapter 35 or Chapter 1606 term, read with the student's Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery records.**

**Rule.** From the days given back so worked out, the days equal to any part of the resulting education overpayment that VA has forgiven are taken off, because entitlement paid for by VA stays charged.

**The amount forgiven** follows the student's debt records:
1. when a waiver credit is posted on an education debt and a waiver decision is on file, the forgiven amount is the waiver credits, added together;
2. when a compromise credit is posted and a compromise decision is on file, it is the compromise credits, added together;
3. otherwise nothing is forgiven.

**Turning the amount into days.** The forgiven amount is turned into days over a 30-day month at the flat monthly rate matching the daily charge of the credits certified on the restored term: the full-time rate for a charge of 1 a day, the three-quarter-time rate for 0.75, the half-time rate for 0.5 and the less-than-half-time rate for 0.25, whatever training time the certification itself records. The forgiven amount is multiplied by 30 and divided by that rate. The days are rounded half up to a whole day only once, after the forgiven days are taken off, and are never fewer than none.

| Debt records | Amount forgiven |
|---|---|
| Waiver credit posted and waiver decision on file | Waiver credits |
| No waiver on those terms; compromise credit posted and compromise decision on file | Compromise credits |
| Waiver decision on file but no waiver credit posted, and no compromise on those terms | Nothing |
| Neither | Nothing |

**Worked case (hypothetical Chapter 30 student, credits certified charged 1 a day).** A waiver credit of $1259.00 is posted and a waiver decision is on file. At the full-time rate of $2518.00, $1259.00 multiplied by 30 and divided by 2518 is 15 days. Days given back worked out at 40.4 become 25.4 and are rounded once to 25. Had the days given back been 10, the result would be none rather than a negative figure.
